content.short: zeroShadow provides blockchain intelligence and incident response after hacks and thefts.
content.description: zeroShadow provides Web3 incident response and threat intelligence, reachable through the SEAL911 emergency channel when a protocol is under active attack. Its team has worked on major incidents including the KelpDAO hack, and publishes post-incident analysis afterwards. Services span a virtual security operations centre, a customer care program and support for financial services firms. A real-time threat intelligence API exposes the same data platform its responders use.
